About VOLVO CE

Engineering a smarter industrial future

Volvo CE combines industrial expertise with intelligent automation to create safer, more productive material-handling operations.

Vision

To lead the future of autonomous and intelligent construction solutions by delivering innovative automation technologies that improve productivity, safety, and sustainability across industries.

Mission

To provide reliable, scalable, and customer-focused automation solutions that enable businesses to optimize operations, enhance efficiency, and achieve long-term growth.

Industries We Serve

Manufacturing

Supporting modern production facilities with automated material movement, intelligent workflows, and enhanced operational efficiency.

Warehousing & Logistics

Streamlining inventory movement and warehouse operations through reliable transportation and automation technologies.

Automotive Industry

Improving production line logistics through automated delivery systems, intelligent routing, and smart factory integration.

Smart Factories

Enabling Industry 4.0 initiatives with connected automation systems, real-time monitoring, and autonomous operations.

Automation Technologies

Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR)

AMRs intelligently navigate industrial facilities using advanced sensors and mapping technologies to transport materials safely and efficiently.

Learn More

Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV)

AGV solutions provide reliable route-based material transport for repetitive industrial operations with maximum precision and productivity.

Learn More

Pallet Transport Systems

Automated pallet handling systems improve supply chain flow, reduce manual intervention, and increase operational efficiency.

Learn More

About Us

Engineering a smarter industrial future

Volvo CE AMR combines industrial expertise with intelligent automation to create safer, more productive material-handling operations.

Vision

To lead the future of autonomous and intelligent construction solutions by delivering innovative automation technologies that improve productivity, safety, and sustainability across industries.

Mission

To provide reliable, scalable, and customer-focused automation solutions that enable businesses to optimize operations, enhance efficiency, and achieve long-term growth.

Who We Are

Volvo CE AMR is committed to providing innovative automation solutions that improve productivity, safety, and operational efficiency in manufacturing plants and warehouse environments.

Our Vision

To become a global leader in warehouse automation by developing intelligent Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), and smart Industry 4.0 solutions that improve productivity, safety, and efficiency.

  • ✔ Global Innovation

Our Mission
